card.name: Of/at/from before a university name
card.fires_on: Small linking words like 'of', 'at' or 'from' right after a person's name or job (professor, postdoc, position) and just before a university or institute name.

modes.label: Person of/from a university
modes.description: Name of an academic followed by 'of' or 'from' leading into the university.
modes.example: Professor John Bowers<< of>> the University of California, Santa Barbara,

modes.label: Role or work at an institution
modes.description: 'at' after a job, position or career, before the institution.
modes.example: accepting a position<< at>> Brown University, where he still teaches.

card.writes: Promotes words like 'industry' and 'ingroup', suggesting an organization or institution name comes next, though the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that links a scholar or job to the university or institute that comes next.
